name: shape-path-morph
title: SVG Path Morph
description: Một đường SVG biến mượt từ hình tròn sang hình thoi rồi sang một hình hữu cơ, các điểm điều khiển nội suy theo nhau.

moworks.author: takayu

options.shapes: path d strings with the same commands (circle, diamond, organic)
options.keys: s: [hold A until, B reached, hold B until, C reached, end]

credit.author: TakayuStudio (motion-reference)
credit.licence: No licence stated: idea and numbers only
credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio svg-path-morph, written here): Three paths with matching commands (4 cubic segments each): circle A -> diamond-ish B -> organic C; CSS d interpolation, no wrapper scale, easeInOutCubic, 1000 ms per leg. Demo loop 2.2 s: hold A to 12 %, B at 38 %, C at 66 %, hold C. Site card (sh-morph): circle -> star -> square -> triangle -> circle, 64 resampled points r 56, each morph 600 ms ease-in-out after a 300 ms hold. Params: duration (1 s) · paths: hình A / B / C · ease (power2.inOut).
moworks.titleVi: Hình SVG biến qua ba dạng
